style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: she sits in a rolling office chair all clip and never stands; the belt of mink coats shoves the chair left on its casters in EVERY beat, so coats and tags tear past at double speed; her arms and mouth work in EVERY beat as it rolls; a near coat wipes the lens every beat; she fills half the frame height; camera rides beside the chair low, moving every beat, new shot size each beat; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a brown mink coat, powdery wings, feathered antennae, round belly, seated in a black office chair on five casters
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a green clerk visor darting ahead at lens all clip; A SWARM of moths crossing the lens every beat
props: ONE folder of bills in her lap; ONE long strip of bills unrolling from it; ONE red aerosol can in the clerk moth legs; ONE rubber gas mask with a filter snout; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the strip whips behind the chair from 1.3 on; the can and mask are the clerk's
environment: a sunlit aisle packed with mink coats on two belt rails, brass hangers, fluttering price tags

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA, GLO-zhut, sche-TA, dol-GHI, TAK-zhe, do-YE-la
audio.pacing: 0.4-4.3 one breath, a short breath at 4.3, 4.3-6.4 one breath; after 6.4 not a word, only the sneeze and sfx
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: belt rumble and caster rattle all clip, dry wing flutter, fur ripping, a hissing jet at 6.4, one huge wet sneeze at 6.9

timeline.a: the chair shoots into frame with her in it, coats tearing past
she chews her own sleeve as the chair rolls left and a coat sweeps the lens and clears
she yanks the folder off her lap, a strip of bills bursts across the frame, chair rolling
she shoves a hanging coat away, fur splitting wide across the lens, the chair speeding up
she swats brass hangers as she rolls by, they clatter past the lens, coats swinging wide
the chair whips round a bend, the strip trailing behind it, tags tearing loose
she hauls herself to the far rail by a coat sleeve, coats sweeping between her and the lens
she leans out of the rolling chair at the lens, hangers and tags tearing past
the chair races past the last stripped hanger, the swarm tearing across the lens
the clerk moth swings out at the lens and fires the can, a white jet raking her as the chair rolls through
chest-up: she sneezes hard at the lens, fur wads and tags blasting past camera, chair still rolling
the clerk moth flings the mask past the lens, she catches it and hauls it over her head, rolling
chest-up, mask on: she rips fur off her sleeve and stuffs it into the filter snout at the lens, rolling
the chair carries her at the lens, she chews through the filter, coats and swarm tearing past both ways

must_appear: she stays in the rolling chair all clip; at 6.4 the jet hits her while the chair rolls on; at 6.9 chest-up she sneezes at the lens; at 7.2 she pulls the mask on; at 7.7 she stuffs fur into the filter snout
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a still background, a stopped belt, a chair at rest, the hero standing or walking, a distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, human hands, speech after 6.4
